name: Cratejoy
description_en:
Cratejoy is a hosted commerce system designed around subscription boxes. It combines recurring subscriber management and fulfilment tools with two distinct routes to market: a Cratejoy Marketplace listing and a merchant’s own subscription website.

A Marketplace-only listing is not the same as buying the website platform. Channel attribution also matters financially because Marketplace referral fees are additional to platform transaction fees and payment-processing charges.
description_zh:
Cratejoy 是围绕订阅盒设计的托管电商系统，结合周期订阅及履约管理，并有 Cratejoy Marketplace 上架和商家自有订阅网站两种销售路径。

仅在 Marketplace 上架，不等于购买自有网站平台。渠道归属也直接影响费用：Marketplace 推荐费在平台交易费及支付处理费之外另计。

core_features.explanation_en: Customers can update details or skip renewals while merchants manage subscriptions and orders.
core_features.explanation_zh: 客户可更新资料或跳过续费，商家管理订阅及订单。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose marketplace-only or a plan including a custom website.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择仅市场上架或包含自有网站的方案。

core_features.explanation_en: Use shipping exports, labels, CSV data and API connections for operations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用配送导出、标签、CSV 和 API 连接开展运营。

zh: 规划从续费到发货的周期
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation scenario, not observed customer adoption.

pricing.billing_basis: Plan subscription plus 1.25% + US$0.10 transaction fee, applicable 15% Marketplace referral fee and additional payment processing.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 规划从续费到发货的周期
sections.en: A monthly box seller must align renewal, customer cutoff and shipment preparation. Cratejoy documents subscriber-managed details, skipped renewal cycles, cancellations, partial refunds and shipping exports. Start with one normal renewal, one skipped cycle and one changed address; ensure the shipment list matches the paid cycle. This is an evaluation proposal, not an executed billing or fulfilment test.
sections.zh: 月度订阅盒卖家需协调续费、客户修改截止日及备货。Cratejoy 文档列出订阅人自助资料、跳过续费周期、取消、部分退款及配送导出。可先检查正常续费、跳过一次及修改地址三种情形，确保发货清单对应已付周期。本文未实际收费或履约。

sections.title_en: Separate marketplace acquisition from owning a storefront
sections.title_zh: 区分市场获客与自有店面
sections.en: Marketplace Only provides a listing route; Essentials and Advanced include a merchant website as well. The product allows customizable storefront HTML/CSS and one-time products alongside subscriptions, but code-level theme access does not make the hosted service open source. Decide which orders originate on the marketplace before comparing channel economics. No Marketplace traffic or seller outcome figures were independently verified.
sections.zh: Marketplace Only 提供上架路径，Essentials、Advanced 还包含商家网站。产品允许定制店面 HTML／CSS，以及在订阅之外销售一次性商品，但主题代码访问不等于托管服务开源。比较渠道成本前应区分订单是否来自市场。本文未独立核实市场流量或商家效果数字。

sections.title_en: Add subscription, transaction, referral and processing fees
sections.title_zh: 合计订阅、交易、推荐及支付处理费
sections.en: The retrieved annual-billing equivalents are US$24.99/month for Marketplace Only, US$59 for Essentials and US$159 for Advanced; monthly-billed counterparts are US$29, US$79 and US$199. The page lists 1.25% plus US$0.10 transaction fees and an additional 15% Marketplace referral fee. Marketplace-only text explicitly includes renewals in that referral charge. The features page says payment-processor fees are additional, so these rates are not the entire cost of taking payment. Confirm the current fee base and attribution rules.
sections.zh: 读取的年付折算为 Marketplace Only 每月 24.99 美元、Essentials 59 美元、Advanced 159 美元；逐月付款分别为 29、79、199 美元。页面列出 1.25% 加每笔 0.10 美元交易费，另有 Marketplace 15% 推荐费；仅市场方案明确把续费也计入推荐收费。功能页说明支付处理费另计，因此上述费率不是全部收款成本。应确认当前费基及渠道归属规则。

sections.title_en: Check the recovery tools and shipping integrations
sections.title_zh: 核对恢复工具及配送集成
sections.en: Advanced adds named capabilities including Advanced Dunning and TaxJar integration. Features mention ShipStation and Pirate Ship, but a listed integration is not evidence of your exact shipment or retry configuration. Bring a failed renewal and cancellation-after-payment case to evaluation. Tax calculation tooling does not by itself establish a merchant’s filing obligations.
sections.zh: Advanced 增加 Advanced Dunning、TaxJar 集成等具名功能；功能页还列出 ShipStation、Pirate Ship。列出集成不能证明具体配送和重试配置可用。评估应包含续费失败及付款后取消；税额计算工具也不能直接确定商家的申报责任。

sections.title_en: Use a subscription-box workflow as the deciding test
sections.title_zh: 按订阅盒流程决定是否适用
sections.en: Recurring physical-box businesses have a clear evaluation case. A SaaS access-control product or one-off catalogue may not need the rebilling/shipping model. Prepare product options, renewal cadence, payment gateway and fulfilment deadlines. No hands-on shipment, recovery, licence agreement or export completeness check was completed; the advertised 14-day trial is not permanent free service.
sections.zh: 周期实物盒业务有明确评估理由；SaaS 权益产品或一次性目录可能不需要这种续费配送模型。应准备商品选项、续费节奏、支付网关和履约期限。本文未实测配送、恢复、许可合同或导出完整性；官网 14 天试用不是永久免费服务。
